spell.stonkstimecore.lose_money.guide: Cast on a player to steal their time.
spell.stonkstimecore.slow_down.guide: On cast, slow down time for a few minutes.
spell.stonkstimecore.speed_up.guide: On cast, speed up time for a few minutes.
spell.stonkstimecore.boost.guide: Targets nearby entities and projects them away from you.
spell.stonkstimecore.mirror.guide: Cast an orb which, on impact, flips the screen of nearby players.
spell.stonkstimecore.growth_spurt.guide: Cast an orb which, on impact, makes nearby entities taller.
spell.stonkstimecore.shrinkflation.guide: Cast an orb which, on impact, makes nearby entities smaller.
spell.stonkstimecore.timeless.guide: Cast an orb which, on impact, makes nearby players lose money when receiving damage.
spell.stonkstimecore.hot_potato.guide: When cast on self, apply the Hot Potato effect. If a player with the Hot Potato punches another, the Hot Potato gets passed to the hit player. Once the timer runs out, the player dies.
spell.stonkstimecore.lifelink.guide: On cast, starts a Lifelink event, where if someone dies, everyone dies.
